description:
How each virtual observer served by a NetRID display provider behaves.

monitoring.benchmarker.configurations.users.NetRIDObserverBehaviorSpecification, as defined in monitoring/benchmarker/configurations/users.py

$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

area.description: The center of each observation is drawn uniformly at random within this area.

max_observation_period_duration.description: Duration of each observation period is drawn uniformly at random between min_observation_period_duration and this value.

mean_time_between_observation_periods.description: Time between the end of an observation period and the start of the observer's next observation period is exponentially distributed with this mean.

min_observation_period_duration.description: Duration of each observation period is drawn uniformly at random between this value and max_observation_period_duration.

query_interval.description: While observing, the observer queries its display provider for flights in its observed rectangle this often.

view_lat_size.description: Height, in degrees of latitude, of the rectangle observed (centered on the observation center).

view_lng_size.description: Width, in degrees of longitude, of the rectangle observed (centered on the observation center).
